items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Because for a long time he was in my corner.

ctx.x: the kind of people that they had in there, they didn't have too--they had someone like Billie Holiday but they didn't have a band like yours. They didn't have a band that was entertaining as such; they had a band--Eddie Haywood's band played but they didn't do any singing or anything. They were a playing band.
Because for a long time he was in my corner. Later he got where he wasn't in my corner for some reason. He was a little strange.
